product.problem: Architects need traceable evidence before changing software boundaries.
product.benefit: Tests architecture hypotheses against scoped graphs and source counter-evidence.
product.input: Public HTTPS GitHub repository URL or local source folder; optional investigation goal and graph export.
product.output: Cited review report, suggested follow-up tasks, and complete query/model/knowledge audit.
product.how_it_works: Freezes sources, builds required graph families on demand, assesses hypotheses, and validates source citations.
